svg.text: ESP32-S3-N16R8 · ADS1115 · NTC×2 · DS18B20×2 · SM6004 · 4-20mA Conv×2 · MCP4728 · BSS138 Shifter · MCP23017 · SSR×2 | v1.1.1
GPIO 26–32: Flash/PSRAM | GPIO 19–20: USB D−/D+ | GPIO 43–44: UART0
Single common ground — all modules + PSUs
① All ADS1115 A0–A3 inputs: 100nF ceramic cap to GND
② MCP4728 on 5V via BSS138 — ADS1115/MCP23017 on 3.3V
③ DS18B20: one 4.7kΩ pull-up for the entire 1-Wire bus
④ I²C: onboard pull-ups on ADS1115 — do not stack
⑥ SSR: GPIO direct drive (3.3V → optocoupler input)
⑦ MCP4728 #2 (0x61): reprogram address before install
⑧ Schematic must be updated with every wiring change
